classifier.input: completed one-hour closes known at order submission
classifier.up_or_down: both windows agree at their thresholds
classifier.range: both windows are below their thresholds
classifier.order_policy: existing 60-minute order life after qualifying submission

entry.fill: first 15-minute high at or above the limit, at limit price

exits.intrabar_fill: hard stop active; only the candle close can confirm an after-fill favorable move
exits.elapsed_time_for_intrabar_fill: from end of first touching 15-minute candle
